item.title: Cells move 4/43: queue moves into packages/queue behind shims
item.criterion: Cells move 4 of 43 (RFC 0006; plan entry 4 in packages/codemap/data/plan/cells.json): the 2 paths the entry lists for package queue move with git mv to their planned targets under packages/queue, and packages/queue/index.js is the front door, re-exporting the 2 modules other code imports. Each of those old paths keeps a re-export shim; nothing else outside the cell changes except path-map.json and the cell lint baseline. The cell lint counts change as the entry states (legacySource 0, shims +2, boundaries +2) and none rises; node packages/codemap/src/io/cells/scripts/plan.js --moved queue passes, and the full suite passes on Node 22.13 and 24.
